faqs.a: For sprints, usually within two weeks of the signed brief. For project and retainer engagements, four to six weeks from sign-off — we keep capacity intentionally short so the team can stay deep on each engagement.

faqs.q: Do you work outside the UAE?
faqs.a: The studio is based in Dubai and our focus is the UAE market. We occasionally take on international projects when the brief is a strong fit — for those we run on UAE hours and align one regular meeting in your timezone.

faqs.q: What does a typical engagement cost?
faqs.a: Sprints start at AED 24,000. Project engagements typically range AED 60,000–180,000 depending on scope. Retainers begin at AED 18,000 / month with a six-month minimum. We'll send indicative pricing with the first proposal.

faqs.q: Can you work in Arabic and English in parallel?
faqs.a: Always. Every deliverable is built bilingual from the first line of copy — type, layout, motion and tone tested in both languages before launch. We don't treat Arabic as a translation pass.

processPage.headline: A clear path from brief to launch — and beyond.
processPage.body: Four phases, run in tight loops. Every phase ships something useful, so momentum compounds and nothing waits until the end. You’ll see real work, real numbers and real trade-offs at every demo, never a deck saved for the finale.
processPage.phase1Body: We start by listening. Stakeholder interviews, audits and field research turn ambition into a sharp, signed-off brief. By the end of this phase you know exactly what we’re solving, why it matters now and what ‘done’ looks like — in language the whole team can repeat.
processPage.phase2Body: Strategy, narrative and a roadmap the whole team can rally around. We make the trade-offs visible and the bets explicit, so the work that follows is honest, fast and unmistakably yours. No ninety-page decks — just decisions that move us forward.
processPage.phase3Body: Identity, interfaces, software and physical builds — shaped in tight loops with weekly demos and one shared backlog. You see real work every week, give feedback against the live thing, and ship knowing it has already been pressure-tested by everyone who needs to live with it.
processPage.phase4Body: Go-live, measurement, optimisation and the next chapter. We stay close after launch, not just before it — instrumenting what matters, learning fast and turning the next quarter’s bets into the next sprint’s backlog.
processPage.engagementTitle: Three ways to work with us.
processPage.engagementBody: Pick what fits the moment. We’ve shaped each model around the kind of work it suits best — and you can move between them as the project evolves.
processPage.engagement1Body: A fixed scope with a clear start, middle and end. Ideal for launches, rebrands and one-time platform builds where the destination is known.
processPage.engagement2Body: An ongoing partnership for teams that ship constantly — content, performance, product iterations and brand stewardship under one roof.
processPage.engagement3Body: Two to six focused weeks to crack a specific problem — a positioning sprint, a prototype, a campaign concept. Pressure-tested and ready to scale.

privacyPage.headline: How we handle your data.
privacyPage.intro: This notice explains what we collect when you visit regaliavowstech.com or get in touch with the studio, how we use it and the rights you have over it. We collect only what we need to respond to enquiries and to deliver the work we are engaged to perform.
privacyPage.lastUpdated: Last reviewed: May 2026. We refresh this notice annually and whenever practice changes — please review with counsel before launch.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.body: Regalia Vows Tech is an independent design and technology studio based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. References to ‘we’, ‘us’ or ‘the studio’ in this notice mean Regalia Vows Tech. You can reach our data point of contact at hello@regaliavowstech.com.

sections.title: 2. What we collect
sections.body: When you fill the contact form we collect the name, email, company name, project category, indicative budget and the message you write to us. When you visit the site we collect standard server logs (IP, user agent, referrer, timestamp) and anonymous aggregated analytics. We do not collect special-category personal data and we ask you not to send it to us.

sections.title: 3. Why we collect it
sections.body: To reply to your enquiry, to scope and deliver projects you have engaged us for, to keep the site secure and to understand which pages are useful so we can improve them. We never sell your data and we do not share it with third parties for advertising.

sections.title: 4. Lawful basis
sections.body: We process contact-form data on the basis of your consent (you chose to write to us) and our legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries. For active client engagements we process data on the basis of the contract we signed with you.

sections.title: 5. How long we keep it
sections.body: Contact-form messages: 24 months from your last interaction, then deleted. Active project files: for the duration of the engagement plus seven years to satisfy UAE record-keeping obligations. Server logs: 90 days, rotating.

sections.title: 6. Who we share it with
sections.body: Trusted infrastructure providers we cannot operate the business without — our email host, hosting platform, analytics provider and accounting software. All are bound by data-processing agreements. We do not transfer data outside the GCC except where the service provider is based in a region with equivalent protections.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and analytics
sections.body: We use one first-party cookie to remember your language preference. We use privacy-friendly analytics that aggregates page views without tracking individuals across sites. There are no advertising cookies, no third-party trackers and no fingerprinting.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us at any time to confirm what data we hold about you, to correct it, to delete it, to export it in a portable format or to restrict how we use it. Write to hello@regaliavowstech.com and we will respond within 30 days. If you are unhappy with our response you can lodge a complaint with the relevant UAE supervisory authority.

sections.title: 9. Security
sections.body: Data in transit is encrypted with TLS. Production systems are access-controlled, audited and patched on a regular cadence. We follow the principle of least privilege internally and we run an annual security review.

sections.title: 10. Children
sections.body: Our site and services are aimed at businesses and adult professionals. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18. If you believe a child has provided personal data, write to us and we will delete it.

sections.title: 11. Changes to this notice
sections.body: We may update this notice when the law, our practice or the services we offer change. We will date every revision at the top. Material changes will be flagged at the top of the page for 30 days.

sections.title: 12. Contact
sections.body: Questions, requests or complaints about privacy go to hello@regaliavowstech.com with the subject line ‘Privacy request’. We monitor that inbox during business hours and respond within one working day.

termsPage.headline: The rules of engagement.
termsPage.intro: These terms describe how the regaliavowstech.com website may be used and the framework that governs studio engagements. Specific projects are governed by the bespoke contracts we sign with each client; in case of conflict the project contract prevails.
termsPage.lastUpdated: Last reviewed: May 2026. Please review with counsel before launch.

sections.title: 1. About these terms
sections.body: By using this site you accept the terms set out below. If you do not accept them, please don’t use the site. The site is provided by Regalia Vows Tech, an independent studio incorporated in the United Arab Emirates.

sections.title: 2. Engagements and scope
sections.body: Information on this site about our capabilities, packages and indicative pricing is for guidance only. A binding engagement starts only when both parties sign a project contract setting out scope, deliverables, timeline and price. We work to that contract, and any change in scope is recorded as a written change order.

sections.title: 3. Intellectual property
sections.body: On full payment and unless otherwise stated in the project contract, all deliverables produced specifically for you become your property. We retain ownership of underlying tools, frameworks and methodologies we developed independently, and we keep the right to feature finished work in our portfolio after launch unless you ask us not to.

sections.title: 4. Payment
sections.body: Project work is invoiced according to the milestone schedule in the contract. Retainers are invoiced monthly in advance. Invoices are due within 14 days unless otherwise agreed. Late payment may pause active work and incur a fair recovery fee in line with UAE commercial practice.

sections.title: 5. Confidentiality
sections.body: Both parties keep each other’s non-public business information confidential during and after the engagement. Confidential information may be disclosed only to people who need to know it to perform the work and who are bound by equivalent obligations. This clause survives the end of the engagement for three years.

sections.title: 6. Warranty and quality
sections.body: We perform the work with reasonable skill and care, using qualified people and current best practice. Where deliverables include software, we warrant that they are free from material defects at the point of acceptance and we will fix any defects reported within 30 days of acceptance at no additional cost.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the extent permitted by UAE law, our total liability for any engagement is capped at the fees paid to us for that engagement in the 12 months immediately preceding the claim. We are not liable for indirect, consequential, special or punitive damages, or for loss of profit, revenue, data or goodwill, unless caused by our gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

sections.title: 8. Termination
sections.body: Either party may terminate an engagement on 30 days’ written notice. We will be paid for work done up to the termination date and for any non-cancellable commitments we made on your behalf. We will hand over work-in-progress in a usable state and assist a reasonable handover for up to 30 days at our standard rate.

sections.title: 9. Use of this website
sections.body: You may browse the site for any lawful purpose. You may not scrape it, attempt to access systems you are not authorised to use, upload malicious content via any forms, or use the site in any way that breaches applicable law. We may suspend access to anyone who breaches these rules.

sections.title: 10. Third-party content
sections.body: Where the site links to or embeds content from third parties (case studies, client trademarks, articles, social media), the third parties retain ownership of their material and govern its use under their own terms. We make every effort to credit accurately.

sections.title: 11. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms when our practice or the law changes. The current version is the one published on this page; the date at the top reflects the last revision. Substantive changes that affect existing engagements will always be agreed in writing on the project contract.

sections.title: 12. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates as applied in the Emirate of Dubai. Any dispute is to be resolved by the courts of Dubai, unless the parties have agreed an alternative forum in the relevant project contract.

aboutPage.headline: An independent studio at the seam of craft, code and commerce.
aboutPage.intro: Regalia Vows Tech is a small, senior studio in Dubai. We work with UAE founders and operators on the launches that will define their next chapter — and we treat a logo with the same obsessive care as a production-grade web platform.
aboutPage.founderTitle: We started this studio for the projects nobody else would take whole.
aboutPage.founderBody: For years I watched briefs get carved up between vendors who never met. The brand agency couldn’t talk to the engineers; the engineers couldn’t talk to the people running the launch; nobody owned the whole arc. Regalia Vows Tech exists to keep all of that under one roof — a small, senior team in Dubai that takes responsibility for the brand, the platform and what happens after launch.

timeline.text: Studio founded in Dubai as a small, senior team — brand, web and motion under one roof.
First UAE founder engagements shipped; bilingual EN/AR delivery model formalised.
Real estate and lifestyle brand sites delivered for Dubai-based operators.
Editorial bilingual site shipped for a Dubai luxury brand; first international engagement (US-facing brand site with product authentication system).
Studio focus refined around brand, web and applied AI for UAE founders — with selected international work when the brief fits.

values.title: Craft
values.body: Detail is the difference between work that ships and work that lasts. We sweat the kerning, the hover state and the dB level — because the audience always feels the things we hoped they’d miss.

values.title: Clarity
values.body: Plain writing, clear scopes and decisions made in the room. If we can’t explain it to your CFO in a sentence, we haven’t finished thinking about it. The work is only ever as honest as the brief that drives it.

values.title: Curiosity
values.body: We hire for it. We protect time for it. We hand it to clients. The teams who let us bring questions to the table get the strongest work; the teams who answer ‘because we’ve always done it that way’ get exactly that.

values.title: Care
values.body: For people, for data, for the work and for the launches that follow. We pick up the phone post-launch, we own the bugs we ship and we never treat handover as someone else’s problem.

values.title: Courage
values.body: Strong work needs a brave room. We tell you when an idea isn’t worth pursuing, when a deadline is wishful thinking and when the safer route is the wrong one. You can disagree — and often should.

values.title: Continuity
values.body: We work with a small number of clients each year and we stay close after launch — long arcs let us think in seasons rather than sprints, and that’s where compounding really shows up.

aboutPage.principlesBody: They sound obvious. They aren’t, in practice. We test new hires and new clients against these — and we walk away from work that needs us to break them.

principles.title: One studio, one room.
principles.body: No sub-sub-contractors. Designers, engineers and producers sit in the same standup and share one backlog.

principles.title: Show, don’t deck.
principles.body: Weekly demos of the real thing. The slide that summarises the work is always shorter than the work itself.

principles.title: Decide on dates.
principles.body: Every decision has a person and a date. Open loops are tracked in writing and closed in days, not quarters.

principles.title: Measure what matters.
principles.body: Every brief carries two or three metrics worth defending to a CFO. Vanity numbers stay out of the deck.

principles.title: Stay after launch.
principles.body: We instrument what we ship, watch it land and tune it. The next quarter is part of this engagement, not the next pitch.

founderPage.name: Sheikh Mohammad Ali
founderPage.lead: The person behind Regalia Vows Tech — and the conviction that great brands, strong technology and memorable experiences should come from one room.
founderPage.manifesto: The brief is never simple. It is only simple when nobody is being honest about it.
founderPage.storyP1: Sheikh Mohammad Ali founded Regalia Vows Tech in Dubai in 2022, after watching too many briefs get carved up between agencies that never met each other. The brand agency couldn't talk to the engineers. The engineers couldn't talk to the event producers. Nobody took responsibility for the whole arc.
founderPage.storyP2: The studio started with a single conviction: that the best results come when the people making the brand, building the platform and producing the event sit in the same room and share one backlog. That model hasn't changed.
founderPage.storyP3: Today Regalia Vows Tech works with UAE founders and operators on the launches that define their next chapter — from positioning and identity through to product, automation and live experience.
founderPage.beliefsBody: After three years running the studio, these are the beliefs that have held up under pressure.

beliefs.title: Integrated or nothing.
beliefs.body: The work degrades every time it passes a handover. One studio, one room, one backlog — that's the only model that produces work the whole team is proud to sign.

beliefs.title: Craft is the strategy.
beliefs.body: The detail the client doesn't consciously notice is what makes them trust you. A well-kerned headline, a hover state that feels alive, a production that ends on time — these are the things that compound.

beliefs.title: Honesty before comfort.
beliefs.body: If the brief is wrong, the right answer is to say so in week one. A brave conversation at the start costs a day. A polite silence at the start costs the whole project.

beliefs.title: Build for the next decade.
beliefs.body: Every brief carries a longer arc than the deadline suggests. We build systems that outlast the first campaign and platforms that the next hire can extend without calling us.

founderPage.noteQuote: I started this studio because I wanted to build things that last — brands and platforms that a founder is still proud of in five years, not just five weeks after launch. Every project we take is a bet on that belief.
founderPage.connectBody: Whether it's a brief, an idea or just a question — write to the studio and Sheikh or one of the senior team will reply within one business day.
